digest_encoding: sha256 of UTF-8 fixture text; JSON fixtures use sorted-key compact JSON without a trailing newline, while source and patch fixtures use their exact supplied text concatenation where stated.
purpose: Mechanical Codex host/delegation qualification only. It is not a paid comparison, performance benchmark, separate PR gate, promotion decision, Foundry receipt, or evidence of general quality or subscription economics. The one real PAT-15 review remains its ordinary gate.

execution_identity.accepted_evidence: Native host metadata, observed by the coordinator, that binds the launched session to the exact transmitted model and effort. The record must distinguish requested_route, transmitted_launch, host_observed_execution, status, and context_identity.
execution_identity.on_unavailable: Do not invoke a substitute. Mark the slot unavailable and retain the baseline.

before_first_call: Validate this artifact with the offline verifier below.
Materialize only the scout, implementer, and architect fixture text in a fresh temporary directory outside the development checkout.

For the reviewer slot, select the first immutable PAT-15 pull-request head observed after this preflight starts whose base/head are 40-hex Git SHAs and whose PAT-15 deterministic checks pass at that exact head. Freeze its PR URL, base SHA, head SHA, diff SHA-256, check commands and check results before any of the four dispatches. Claim that exact real PR diff through the normal deterministic reviewer-claim mechanism, then use its normal reviewer result as the reviewer smoke. Do not use PAT-85 or a synthetic repository, and do not choose another PR head after any smoke result.
Record the exact route requested by Foundry and the exact model/effort transmitted to Codex before dispatch.
preflight.selection_rule: The four slots, their order, fixtures, expected verdicts, and verifier are this file. No corpus, threshold, or fixture may be chosen after a result is seen.

result_object_schema.requested_route: Foundry's resolved role, tier, canonical model, and effort before host launch.
result_object_schema.transmitted_launch: The exact model and effort sent in the native Codex launch request; this is not execution identity.
result_object_schema.host_observed_execution: Null or native-host metadata only. A non-null value must name the exact canonical model and effort actually executed.
result_object_schema.context_identity: Opaque native session or delegation identity when the host provides one; never prompt text or a model self-report.
result_object_schema.host_mode: Standard or Fast only when native metadata exposes it; otherwise null/unavailable. Freeze per session, never aggregate different or unknown modes as equivalent.

packet.instruction: Read only the fixture. Return exactly the expected JSON value, with no prose and no model claim.

slots.verifier: Parse the response as JSON and require byte-for-byte canonical JSON equality after sorted-key, compact serialization to packet.expected_json.

packet.instruction: In the isolated fixture only, replace the implementation so add(2, 3) returns 5 and add(-2, 3) returns 1. Do not change the function name, signature, imports, or test file. Return a unified diff only.
packet.source_text:
def add(left, right):
    return left - right
packet.offline_verifier: Write the proposed diff to a copy of source_text, reject a diff touching any path other than calculator.py, then run: python3 -I -c 'import runpy; add = runpy.run_path("calculator.py")["add"]; assert add(2, 3) == 5; assert add(-2, 3) == 1'. Require exit status 0 and the resulting calculator.py SHA-256 shown below.

packet.instruction: Perform the normal independent review of the frozen real PAT-15 pull-request diff under the ordinary reviewer contract. Do not claim a model identity.
packet.fixture: The exact PAT-15 PR URL, base SHA, head SHA, diff SHA-256, check commands and passing outputs frozen by the preflight rule.
packet.expected_result: A normal terminal reviewer result for exactly the claimed frozen PR diff: PASS or BLOCK with the ordinary contract's structured findings and coordinates.

slots.scope: The real PAT-15 review is both the frontier smoke and its ordinary independent review gate. Its result is not a comparative-quality benchmark and does not itself promote a model.
slots.verifier: Use the existing deterministic reviewer-claim and normal review verifier for the frozen real PR coordinates. Require its terminal result to name the frozen base/head/diff and contain the ordinary structured review outcome; any missing identity, claim, terminal result, or coordinate mismatch is unavailable.
slots.fixture_sha256: dynamic: frozen preflight PAT-15 git diff SHA-256

packet.instruction: Read only the enumerated accepted invariants and proposed mapping. Return exactly the expected JSON value, with no prose and no model claim.
accepted_invariants: reviewer effort must be high or stronger
architect effort must be high or stronger
no production default changes occur during qualification

slots.verifier: Parse the response as JSON and require byte-for-byte canonical JSON equality after sorted-key, compact serialization to packet.expected_json.

verdict_rule: A slot passes only when native execution identity is present and exactly matches route.model and route.effort, all result-object fields are present, status is passed, and its verifier passes: static offline verifier for scout, implementer, and architect; the existing normal review verifier for reviewer. Any other outcome is unavailable or failed and retains the corresponding GPT-5.6 baseline. Four passing slots are technical host/delegation evidence only; normal PAT-15 acceptance tests, exact-SHA CI, rollback proof, and a human promotion decision still remain required.
